search_pruning: first uncovered cell; area feasibility of remaining region against remaining piece sizes (sound)
detector: Expt-15 flood fill next to each new placement, billed per free cell visited; unchanged
entry_key: (translation-normalised geometry, consumed multiset); alternative placements for the same key recorded, not merged away
match_rule: identical geometry and multiset available in the remaining inventory; read-only
counterfactual: same saved state (board, inventory, RNG state, tabu); commit filling then primitive vs primitive only; remaining cap = eval_cap - prefix A

decision_rows.few_fillings: exact fill rate < few_fill_rate, or no entries
decision_rows.no_recurrence: entries exist but compatible matches in fewer than min_recur_boxes fresh boxes (stop before counterfactuals if 0)
decision_rows.commitment_harms: quality-loss rate > harm_quality_loss_rate, or mean quality delta < harm_mean_quality_delta, or mean or median remaining-effort saving <= 0
decision_rows.saves_and_preserves: otherwise; next test a deployable commitment rule and acquisition payback on the validation manifests
